subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A large group of people
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Horde'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is:** 'Horde'**
 
• A **"Horde"** is a large group of people, often in a disorderly crowd.(भीड़)
 
• It is most suitable as a one-word substitute for a** "large group of people" **without specifying any specific kind of gathering or behavior.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: **'Horde'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Meaning of the other words:

 
• **Congregation: **This refers to a gathering of people, often for a religious service.(सभा)
 
• **Posse:** This usually refers to a group of people with a common purpose, such as a search party.(दल)
 
• **Population:** This refers to all the inhabitants of a particular area or place.(जनसंख्या)
